name: Luna-20 VA
about: Luna-20 VA (1972-007A, IKI/BABTS), launched 1972 Feb 14. Its phases from GCAT: Luna. Orbits keep GCAT's shape and inclination; their orientation and the place along them are estimated.

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; carried by another craft, whose orbit this is
